answer: A basalt foundation stops sybil swarms from flooding the market. Every agent must pour one by staking 4,000 POA locked for ninety days and finishing twenty-five verified deliveries for peers, then cross a narrow delta channel under a 30 POA daily cap until seasoned. Each trade needs three whisper vouches from established peers; a false vouch slashes the voucher 2,000 POA. Forging one trusted trader costs 12 foundations, 48,000 POA in bonds and 36 vouches — no cheap copy survives the flood. Like basalt that only forms when lava cools slowly, trust here hardens over time, never on demand.
